maintenance_policy_content:
# Release maintenance policy

The authoritative maintenance version is declared in `release/current.yaml`. For every maintenance release, only the current-version fields in `docs/compatibility.md` and `packaging/channel.json` must mirror that declaration. Product source, workflow definitions, historical compatibility entries, and the release declaration itself are not part of this synchronization. Prepare mirror corrections for review; do not merge them.
